'''S-K6''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at the [[Imperial base camp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
S-K6 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Imperial faction's Flashpoint Courier for the Flashpoint "The Battle of Ilum" in the Imperial base camp.<ref name="TOR" />
